item.title: Europe: Ireland Makes One Last Push for a Compromise Before Lithuania’s Presidency
item.description: Ireland has circulated two new compromise texts on EU excise duties after an earlier proposal was withdrawn and rejected by the European Parliament. A vote was postponed until November 9 to allow Sweden, a leading opponent of higher taxes on nicotine pouches, to form a government. Several other member states also have reservations about the proposed rates and their effects. (Published on October 31, 2026byvapingpost.com)
